section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 76 | 500 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 145 | 500 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 93 | 500 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
